gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR adds CSV export to widgets; you are its author, and robin and the acme/reviewers team are also requested reviewers. It covers CSV download and the header format, defers scheduled exports to acme/widgets#46, deliberately buffers the whole file instead of streaming it as the spec records, and leaves the export UI to acme/export-ui.

Two problems block merging, and a required unit check is still running in CI. The build check passed in CI.

1. The exporter writes no header row, so a downloaded file starts with data and a spreadsheet reads the first record as column names. The local test run failed export_header in tests/export.test.mjs (src/export.ts:31).
2. The export guide says exports run nightly, but the button exports when it is clicked, so a reader may wait for a file that never arrives. A fix to the guide is drafted (docs/export.md:8).

Reviewer maria pointed out the missing header, and her point is valid. The drafted reply agrees that the header is missing and says a fix is planned (comment-73). Two of the three items from your previous review are addressed. The branch was rebased onto main and pushed, with one conflict resolved in src/export.ts. One smaller point does not block merging: the export loop repeats the shared paging helper's code (src/export.ts:44), and deliver with nits can take it.

I recommend deliver because both problems have drafted repairs and this is your PR.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - the same, and also replace the repeated paging code with the shared helper.
3. assess - post both problems to the PR as one review and make no repairs.
4. stop - end the run, remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
